title: Reuse the existing REG.RU acceptance mailbox credential only when it is the canonical access sender
acceptance: use only existing protected REG.RU mailbox secrets already required by first-customer acceptance
require the protected IMAP user to equal the canonical access@процент-агро.рф sender before reusing its password
authenticate to sm38.hosting.reg.ru:465 with TLS and send no message during the credential proof
fail before SSH when mailbox credential is missing or belongs to another mailbox
require pinned REG.RU root SSH identity before any production file mutation
create or validate only root-owned mode-0600 auth-mail runtime files in the active Compose working directory
perform no database or deployment mutation
never publish credential values, protected paths, raw SMTP responses or raw environment values
